saved: Saved · visible across the whole site
shareIntro: What appears when someone pastes your site's link (Instagram, messaging apps…) or looks you up on Google.
descriptionHelp: One or two sentences, used when a page does not have its own.
shareImage: Image shown when your site is shared
shareImageHelp: Used when a page has no image of its own (otherwise, the first image on the page). A wide image, around 1200 × 630, works best.
previewTitle: This is how your link will look
noImage: No image: a shared link will appear without a thumbnail.
addDescription: Add a description so it appears here.
